info.name: Commerce API
info.description:
# Commerce API Postman Collection

Full collection for the Django REST Framework eCommerce backend.

### Authentication & Setup
1. Make sure your Django server is running (`python manage.py runserver`).
2. Set `base_url` (default: `http://127.0.0.1:8000`), `email`, and `password` in Collection Variables or Environment.
3. Run **Authentication > Login**. The test script automatically captures `access_token` and `refresh_token` and stores them in your variables.
4. All subsequent authenticated endpoints use Bearer Token (`{{access_token}}`) automatically.

### CoreRenderer Format
The API uses `CoreRenderer` which wraps responses in:
```json
{
  "status": true,
  "status_code": 200,
  "timestamp": "...",
  "data": { ... }
}
```
All test scripts in this collection are written to seamlessly extract data from `response.data` or fallback to root.
